name: voicechat-monorepo
//: Electron applications are released by sislex/agent and sislex/desktop; Core consumes pinned artifacts.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:kb-tools && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:tooling && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.frontend:build-gates: npm run build:frontends && npm run verify:core-ui && npm run frontend:route-gates
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run verify:frontend
scripts.//gate:fast: Проверки изменённых приложений рабочего дерева; общие контракты и неизвестные пути расширяют выбор. gate:all — полный гейт.
scripts.gate:fast:logged: node scripts/long-run.mjs start -- npm run gate:fast
scripts.test:coverage: npm run -w @voicechat/shared test -- --coverage && npm run -w @voicechat/server test -- --coverage
scripts.test:tooling: npm test --prefix packages/kb-tools && node --import tsx --test scripts/release-train.test.mjs scripts/release-train-run.test.mjs scripts/dev-stand.test.mjs scripts/quick-gate.test.mjs scripts/task-gate.test.mjs scripts/task-tests.test.mjs scripts/test-files.test.mjs scripts/core-contracts-release.test.mjs scripts/shared-chat-artifacts.test.mjs scripts/s3-provider-artifacts.test.mjs scripts/browser-ui-release.test.mjs scripts/application-gate.test.mjs scripts/owner-pins.test.mjs scripts/release-composition.test.mjs scripts/release-gate.test.mjs scripts/mark-full-gate.test.mjs scripts/promotion-gate.test.mjs scripts/application-build.test.mjs scripts/owner-application-release.test.mjs scripts/application-frontend.test.mjs scripts/application-deploy.test.mjs scripts/delivery-release.test.mjs scripts/application-compatibility.test.mjs scripts/application-links.test.mjs scripts/component-installation.test.mjs scripts/component-readiness.test.mjs scripts/operations-restore-drill.test.mjs scripts/operations-backup-retention.test.mjs && node --test scripts/affected-check.test.mjs scripts/merge-gate.test.mjs scripts/core-ui-artifact.test.mjs scripts/route-budgets.test.mjs scripts/route-compression.test.mjs scripts/full-gate.test.mjs scripts/browser-gate.test.mjs scripts/kanban-stand-prepare.test.mjs scripts/long-run.test.mjs scripts/system-gate.test.mjs && npm run gate:a07 && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/prod/test_local_image_pins.py && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/prod/test_owner_image_switches.py && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/prod/test_environment_scripts.py && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/prod/release_retention_test.py
scripts.gate:release:full: npm run gate:all && npm run gate:performance && npm run gate:system
scripts.typecheck:kb-tools: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/kb-tools && tsc --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs --target es2022 --module nodenext --skipLibCheck scripts/kb-tools-release.mjs scripts/kb.mjs scripts/kb-search.mjs
